name: scrapex

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL to scrape (use an upstream node's {{$json.url}} or hardcode)

parameters.name: render
parameters.description: auto | http | browser — when in doubt leave as auto

parameters.name: stealth
parameters.description: true = use cloudscraper (anti-bot). Requires scrapex[stealth] on the server.

notes:
scrapex wrapper — assumes uvicorn is running on localhost:8000.

Start the server with:
  pip install scrapex[api]
  uvicorn scrapex.wrappers.fastapi_n8n:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

Response fields available downstream:
  $json.url            final URL (after redirects)
  $json.status         HTTP status code
  $json.title          page <title>
  $json.markdown       page content as markdown
  $json.extracted      {field_name: value} dict when a schema is provided
  $json.render_mode    http | browser | cloudscraper
  $json.error          string or null
  $json.warnings       array of warnings (e.g. selector mismatches)
